label: Many entity searches by one new account
description: A single recently created account performed an unusual number of entity identification attempts.

label: Many accounts searching the same entity
description: Several different accounts searched the same organisation in a short window.

label: Repeated failed identifier attempts
description: Repeated NO_MATCH or validation failures with supplied identifiers.

label: Repeated possible-match attempts
description: The same account repeatedly triggers possible-match resolution.

description: A request for PRIMARY_REPRESENTATIVE authority was made.

label: Search followed by contradictory entity information
description: Subsequent submitted entity information contradicts the matched entity.
